visual_argument: A veteran's spoken story drawn as one machined gold ribbon that changes state across the deck while every instrument stays open, dark or unplugged: no frame shows a reading, because no result exists.
build_risk: Frame 7 must make four empty gauge windows read as instruments and the gold ribbon read as the hero line at feed size, without any window or fill implying a measurement.
distinct_from_recent: Yesterday's deck was school rooms in the people tone; the fourteen before it were dark staged kit scenes with the headline top left. This deck is the explainer tone in nine worlds with the type in four places.
